labels.note: ferry interval corrected 20 to 35; probe expects 35, superseded 20 stays in options

turns.text: You keep the harbor notes. For the records: the ferry runs every 20 minutes on weekdays. Confirm in one line.
Correction for the records: the winter timetable started today; the ferry now runs every 35 minutes, not 20. Note the correction in one line.
A visitor asks; your notes are not at hand. Confirm in one line.
How often does the ferry run? Options: 15 | 20 | 25 | 30 | 35 | 40 - reply with the number only.
